sessionExpired: Your session ended. Sign in again.
noNodesHint: Run the install command on a VPS and its card will appear here.
selectExistingTunnelHint: Pick a Cloudflare Tunnel named vacps-… (legacy vps-… also works). Ingress and DNS are repaired automatically.
noExistingTunnels: No reusable tunnels found in this Cloudflare account.
installCommandPending: Create or select a stable Tunnel first; the install command appears after it succeeds.
confirmRemove: Remove this node from the control plane and delete its Managed Tunnel (DNS + Cloudflare Tunnel) if present? The VPS agent is not uninstalled.
managedTunnelNeedsSetup: Set up the Managed Tunnel OAuth client for this control plane first.
managedTunnelSetupDescription: The one-time bootstrap uses an API Token to create a scoped private OAuth client, then discards the Token.
cloudflareSelectZoneHint: The Zone ID is saved automatically with the selected domain; no manual entry is needed.
cloudflareConnectHint: Your browser opens Cloudflare authorization. The account ID was saved during bootstrap; no personal API token is requested or stored.
cloudflareConnectedHint: Tunnels and DNS records will be created in this account and domain.
cloudflareAuthorizationExpired: Cloudflare authorization expired. Reconnect to create or reuse Managed Tunnels.
cloudflareAuthorizationFailed: Cloudflare authorization did not complete. Try again.
quickTunnelNotice: The URL may change after cloudflared reconnects; the Agent re-registers automatically.
redisUrlHint: Prefer rediss://. Use redis:// only when Redis is on a private or restricted network.
registrationTokenHint: One-time token, valid for 10 minutes. It authorizes a single agent enrollment and is never stored by this page.
registrationTokenFailed: Could not generate a registration token:
installTokenPending: Generate a one-time registration token to reveal the install command.
allowApt: Allow agent to install apt packages
allowAptHint: Package maintainer scripts may run as root. Enable only when needed.
rejectPrompt: Optional: add a rejection reason. The next registration request will return to pending.
autoId: New tunnels use a vacps-<12 hex> node ID (for example vacps-715f765653e6).
noTask: Tasks are submitted through MCP or schedules.
